description: One row per FDA decision. source drugsfda: Drugs@FDA actions from 1939 (decision_code AP approved, TA tentative: blocked by patent/exclusivity); 510k: device clearances from 1976 (SESE cleared); pma: Class III device approvals from 1960 (APPR approved, OK30 30-day supplement accepted). review_priority PRIORITY/STANDARD: drugs; EXPEDITED: devices. No ticker or CIK: applicant is the name as filed. applicant, product_name: case-insensitive substring (1-3 chars: whole word) in a 5,000-row window. More: keyvex.com/docs/tools/get_fda_approvals
name: get_fda_approvals
